recipe_version.title: Spiced Lamb Meatballs with Tomato-Herb Sauce
recipe_version.description: Lamb meatballs seasoned with cumin, coriander, mint, and parsley, browned and simmered in a skillet tomato-herb sauce.

ingredients.name: ground lamb
ingredients.note: not lean beef; lamb is required

ingredients.name: yellow onion
ingredients.note: about 8 oz; half grated into meatballs, half diced for sauce

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.note: 3 minced for meatballs, 2 minced for sauce

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1.25 tsp in meatballs, 0.5 tsp in sauce

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp to brown meatballs, 1 tbsp for sauce aromatics

steps.title: Mix the meatballs
steps.body: In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, beaten egg, panko, grated half onion, 3 cloves minced garlic, half the parsley (1/4 cup), all the mint, cumin, coriander, paprika, red pepper flakes, 1.25 tsp kosher salt, and black pepper. Mix with a fork or clean hands just until combined. Do not overwork. Shape into 16 meatballs, about 1.5 inches each.

steps.title: Brown the meatballs
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Add the meatballs in a single layer, working in two batches if needed. Brown on two sides until a crust forms, about 2 to 3 minutes per side. They will not be cooked through. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Build the tomato-herb sauce
steps.body: Reduce heat to medium. Add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil and the diced onion half. Cook until soft, about 4 minutes. Add the remaining 2 cloves minced garlic and the tomato paste. Stir 1 minute. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and water. Add the remaining 0.5 tsp kosher salt. Simmer 3 minutes, scraping browned bits.

steps.title: Simmer meatballs in sauce
steps.body: Nestle the browned meatballs into the sauce. Simmer uncovered over medium-low, turning once, until the centers read 160 F and the sauce has thickened slightly, about 12 to 14 minutes.

steps.title: Finish with herbs
steps.body: Take the skillet off the heat. Scatter the remaining 1/4 cup parsley over the meatballs and sauce. Serve from the skillet: 4 meatballs with sauce per person. No yogurt, no cheese, no pasta required. kitchen_tested is false.

recipe_version.heat: Medium-high to brown. Medium for sauce aromatics. Medium-low simmer for meatballs in sauce. No oven.
recipe_version.doneness: Meatball centers 160 F. Sauce slightly thickened, spoon-coating. Herbs fresh at the finish. kitchen_tested is false.
